RACS_projection_scope: geometric pushforward of source posterior; NOT a refit with arbitrary declination selection removed
RACS_ablation_scope: diagnostic ablations are not equally qualified models or a probability-weighted model ensemble
novelty_decision: Actual same-source peak-versus-integrated dipole contrast survives paired uncertainty and angular nuisance in a declared Poisson working law. This resolves a source/estimand input defect and supplies a publication candidate on selection-dependent radio morphology; generic estimator/five-view/GLS priority or information superiority is not established. The narrow P4 companion needs one bounded source/component-null qualification, one matched conventional comparison, and manuscript consolidation. Source-matched LSS calibration is required for a physical-excess claim; a RACS nuisance refit is optional for a stronger same-estimand comparison. Original P4 acceptance and NOT_READY_TO_SUBMIT remain unchanged.
